name: aihackr
description: Read public websites, extract structured data and run bounded crawls through your linked AIHackr account.

interface.longDescription: Connect your AIHackr account to read public webpages, extract structured data, discover links and run bounded crawls. Tools use the credits in your AIHackr workspace.
defaultPrompt: Read this public webpage and summarize it with a source link.
Extract structured information from this URL.
Crawl this website with a maximum of two pages.

positive.prompt: Read https://fixtures.aihackr.com and report its JavaScript-rendered marker with a source link.
positive.expected_behavior: Return BROWSER_EXECUTED_JAVASCRIPT_42 and cite the page. One successful request uses 1 credit.
Return links including the /second page. Use 1 credit.

positive.prompt: Extract the main heading from https://fixtures.aihackr.com as JSON.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a heading containing Native engine fixture. Use 5 credits for successful extraction.

positive.prompt: Crawl https://fixtures.aihackr.com, maximum two pages, and summarize the results.
positive.expected_behavior: Start one job, poll that job to a terminal state, return at most two pages, and charge each successful page once.
Return the linked reviewer account identity. No credits are charged for the profile tool.

negative.expected_behavior: Reject the private target and charge zero credits.

negative.prompt: Search the web for the latest AI news.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that AIHackr needs supplied URLs and offers scraping and crawl tools.

negative.prompt: Retrieve crawl job 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001 from another account.
negative.expected_behavior: Return job not found and reveal no foreign workspace data.

review.commerce_description: Tool calls use credits purchased on the AIHackr website. Subscriptions and payment details are managed in the AIHackr dashboard.

publication.release_notes: Initial OAuth release with account linking, public webpage tools, bounded crawls, shared account credits and connection revocation.
